description: The financial status of ONE customer: turnover, open amount, last invoice, last payment, number of documents. Summed from what the source delivered — no balance is computed here, no dunning level, no interest: the accounting system stays the single truth about an amount. IMPORTANT difference between the versions: Sage 100's document search delivers NO open amount and no payment date, so those stay null — null means NOT DELIVERED, not 'paid'. The answer names the gaps of the version it used.

account_id.description: Alternative: a CRM account that is linked to a Sage customer via link_sage_customer.

customer_number.description: The customer number in Sage (Sage 100: kto; Cloud: reference or id).

limit.description: Max documents to read, default 100, cap 500.

version.description: Sage connector to read from: Sage 100 or Sage Business Cloud

name: get_sage_finance_status
